data.name: Jedd
data.gender_notes: Jedd is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Hebrew ‘Yadid’, meaning 'friend' or 'companion'. In the Bible, the name Jedidiah is given to Solomon's son, meaning 'beloved of the Lord'. The name Jedd carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jedd usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's companionship and love.
data.etymology: Jedd belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jedd total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Τζεδ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζεδ είναι μια μορφή του ονόματος Ιούδας ή Ιεδ, που σημαίνει ' άνθρωπος που γνωρίζει' ή 'εκλεκτός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ιούδας αναφέρεται στον Ιούδα, τον αδελφό του Ιησού. Το όνομα Τζεδ μπορεί να έχει σχέση με τη σημασία της γνώσης ή της σοφίας.
